features.title: Why choose Modulia?
features.subtitle: Contemporary, accessible modular homes designed for everyday comfort and fast on-site installation.

items.title: Fast construction
items.description: Modules prefabricated in a controlled factory — fast installation, up to 80% less time than traditional construction.

items.title: Warranty
items.description: Our modular buildings benefit from the two-year warranty, in accordance with applicable regulations. For two years from handover, this warranty covers detachable equipment forming part of the works that shows a functional defect. Where a fault falls under this warranty, our after-sales team intervenes promptly to repair or replace the equipment concerned.

items.title: After-sales service
items.description: Our after-sales service is here to support you after your purchase. Responsive and available, we do everything we can to meet your needs quickly and provide effective solutions. Your satisfaction is our priority.

construction.title: Module construction principle
construction.intro: Every module is built on a square-section galvanised steel frame, with a multi-layer envelope: rock-wool insulation, flame-retardant boards, aluminium and bamboo-fibre finishes, aluminium joinery with LOW-E glazing, and SPC flooring on fibre-cement board.

technicalSpecs.title: Modulia module specifications
technicalSpecs.intro: Structural, thermal and equipment characteristics of our prefabricated modules — designed to last and adapt to every project.

sections.title: General structure
items: Load-bearing structure: galvanised steel or powder-coated steel chassis
Self-supporting frame designed for transport and crane installation
Estimated lifespan: 30 to 50 years depending on maintenance

sections.title: Dimensions & modularity
items: Floor area: from 13 m² to over 100 m² depending on configuration

sections.title: Envelope & insulation
items: Walls: 70 mm rock wool insulation panels
High-performance insulation: XPS + 70 mm rock wool
Acoustic insulation: ≈ 35–45 dB depending on composition

sections.title: Technical equipment
items: Electricity: installation to NFC 15-100 standard, integrated electrical panel
Plumbing: pre-installed hot / cold water networks, PVC drainage

sections.title: Interior fittings
items: Bathroom: shower, WC, pre-installed vanity unit
Terrace: lacquered steel and composite wood (depending on model)

sections.title: Transport & installation
items: Delivery: road transport on a flatbed truck
Transport and crane included within a 30 km radius around Faro
Installation: on a concrete slab, concrete footings or metal piles — prepare at least 3 weeks in advance
Installation time: 2 days per module (water, wastewater and electricity connections included)
